items.title: William "Big Bill" Thompson Interview, 1961-03-01
items.q: No, I don't remember him good.

ctx.x: I told Walter, I said, he'd be great. But he did grow up to be good too. He said, I hear him 9, 11, 9, and I hear him over the television, on the radio, I hear him playing. He said, yeah, he's good. Walter's wonderful.
His brother often played very good too. Eddie Loomis. Remember Eddie Loomis?
No, I don't remember him good.
